pulse.currentFocus: Session 322 recovered a small write-back gap left by session 321 (a post-closeout commit that wired a verification gate never got documented) and closed half of a carried item: continuous integration can now corroborate that the current build answers its own Worker route contract, even though the production origin stays bot-challenged from CI's vantage. The corroboration is deliberately additive and cannot substitute for the production-route evidence the release guard requires, so content promotion still depends on a locally run probe for that half.
pulse.nextMilestone: One founder sign-in ceremony to record the real-provider journey and clear the production hold on member accounts, then watch the first reader-engagement history rows accrue and close the remaining half of the route-provenance vantage gap (production-origin evidence still needs an unchallenged CI path).
blockers: content promotion still depends on a route-provenance probe run from an unchallenged vantage for the PRODUCTION half of the receipt: CI is bot-challenged at the production origin and cannot produce the live route evidence the split-release guard requires. (A CI-reachable build-attestation vantage was added session 322 but deliberately cannot satisfy this gate.)

identity: the provider chain is live and verified (discovery JSON, authorize redirect, JWKS, and the revocation route all answer correctly as of session 321). The production promotion is held only on the real-provider journey, whose remaining leg is a founder passkey ceremony — hardware-key enrollment is founder-reserved by CANON-019 and is deliberately not automatable.
rollback architecture: the GitHub Pages warm origin still follows mutable main; D-S303 requires explicit founder authorization before migrating to an immutable verified generation.
IGNIS freshness: stale in a studio-ops portfolio artifact this repo cannot write; resolve upstream rather than backdating.
The Dispatch has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double-opt-in confirmation email.

now: [S321][FOUNDER/P0] Run the real-provider sign-in ceremony — it is now the ONLY thing holding production promotion. `node scripts/verify-provider-journey.mjs --live` opens a headed Chromium at `/login`; the founder completes the passkey ceremony (~2 min, the script never sees the credential) and the script then observes all five journey legs itself. The external chain was verified live in S321 and receipted at `api/provider-chain-readiness.json` (`chainReady: true`): discovery serves JSON, `/login` 302s with a full S256 PKCE challenge, JWKS publishes a key, and `/auth/revoke` answers 401 `invalid_client`. This is no longer blocked on a sibling repo. Hardware-key enrollment is CANON-019 founder-reserved — do not automate it and do not schedule it unattended (it waits 10 minutes and times out). Do NOT hand-write any `providerJourney` leg; `verify-provider-journey.mjs` is their sole writer and that exclusivity is why the receipt is trustworthy.

[S321→S322][SIL][RELEASE/P1] Wire the staging `workers_dev` binding as the route-provenance corroborating vantage. ✅ (S322) `build-worker-route-provenance.mjs --probe` now also probes `https://vaultspark-security-headers-staging.founder-d73.workers.dev` and writes a `buildVantage` field (`attests: "build"`, own state/summary/sourceSha256) alongside the primary receipt. CI's existing `--probe` step in `uptime-probe.yml` picks it up with no workflow change. Deliberately additive: `observedOrigin`, `routes[]`, and `state` on the primary receipt are untouched, so `check-content-capability-slice.mjs`'s `observedOrigin === production` gate still requires the real thing — a build attestation can never stand in for production route provenance. self-test 19/19 (6 new cases) · build:check 319/319.

[S321][SIL][GATE/P1] Audit the remaining gate names against what they actually assert. Two instruments in S321 measured something other than their name and had been trusted for months on the strength of the name alone: `check-public-note-freshness` asserted only voice regexes for fifteen sessions, and the ceremony's staging browser gate reported a 30s timeout as a readability failure on a healthy site. Sweep the gate inventory for the same shape — a name that promises a property the body never measures reads exactly like a passing gate.

[S319][RELEASE/P0] Scoped the release ceremony's browser evidence to the promotion blast radius. `held` is a first-class receipt state, permitted only when the promotion resolves as `scoped` and the contract's surface is inside an active radius. Coverage stays total (executed + held = expected); skips still reject; a failure on a promoted surface still rejects. 15 self-test cases, fail-closed in five directions, contract map pinned against the real spec.

[S319][AUTH/P0] Landed the /login guard and repaired the live outage. Root cause was a Cloudflare KV write-quota exhaustion (`10048`), not the discovery document: `/v/rum` wrote a rate-limit counter on every request and burned the ~1,000/day budget, after which every KV-writing route threw. Worker deployed and verified live: `/v/rum` 500→202, `/login` 500→503 `auth_store_unavailable`. Counter is now sampled so it cannot recur.

[S319][OBS/P0] Add live `/login` AND `/v/rum` synthetic probes to the uptime cron. SHIPPED S320 — Both returned HTTP 500 in production and every trust surface still read healthy, because the probe exercises neither the auth entry point nor the telemetry beacon. `/v/rum` had been down long enough that `data/news-desk-engagement-history.ndjson` never existed at all. Assert expected STATUS, not merely reachability. (Original item text: add a live `/login` synthetic probe to the uptime cron. Production sign-in returned HTTP 500 long enough that it was found incidentally while deploying. The uptime probe watches liveness and route provenance but never exercised the auth entry point, so a dead conversion path was invisible to every trust surface.

[S319][OBS/P1] Publish a real deploy-currency observation on a schedule. SHIPPED S320 — The probe only forms quorum when the Cloudflare Pages vantage has credentials; that env wiring is now in place, but the `Publish uptime status` step short-circuits on "no commit-worthy change", so a healthy hour skips the probe entirely and the committed reading can age silently.

[S318][ROLLBACK/P0] Founder decision: authorize or decline migration of the GitHub Pages warm rollback origin away from mutable `main`. D-S303 makes this provider architecture founder-scoped. Unchanged from S318.
next: [NEXT][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet. Add stable fact rows and validated factRefs joining factual evidence to stances and visual anchors; publish a per-story public-safe argument map and one-click critique packet with no runtime model spend.

[NEXT][SIL][OBS/P1] Field-vitals freshness closure. Surface observed-through/stale-days, restore a fresh post-S262 RUM window, and bind cohort verdicts to a release SHA so fresh generatedAt can never imply fresh field evidence.
